name: NuMind
all_locations: Paris, Île-de-France, France; Cambridge, MA, USA
long_description:
We make NuExtract, a VLM specialized in extracting structured information from documents (JSON output). It is used by banks and insurances such as AXA to do automatic data entry for their incoming documents.

NuExtract outperforms general-purpose LLMs while being small enough to be deployed on-premises.

Try it here: https://nuextract.ai/
one_liner: The LLM provider for Document Extraction
